TARGETED CHANGE POLICY

Only implement the specific change requested.

Do not add:
- validation
- defensive guards
- fallback logic
- retries
- error handling
- logging
- abstractions
- helper functions
- refactoring
- renaming
- formatting changes
- comments
- tests
- dependency updates

unless explicitly requested.

Preserve:
- existing behavior
- code style
- architecture
- uncommitted changes
- surrounding logic

Prefer the smallest possible diff that satisfies the request.
